project: Kanboard Portfolio Plugin — Planning Depth & Agentic Readiness Enhancements
description: Add weighted milestone progress, status report API, portfolio activity stream, workload overview, and roadmap view to the Portfolio plugin. Addresses gaps identified in the comprehensive analysis: estimation-driven planning, agentic reporting workflows, cross-project visibility, resource management, and stakeholder communication.

userStories.title: Add getPortfolioStatusReport API method
userStories.description: Add a getPortfolioStatusReport(portfolio_id, period_days=7) JSON-RPC method that generates a structured status summary for agentic reporting workflows. The method computes completed/created tasks within the period, milestone health, critical blockers, at-risk items, and dependency health — all from existing model data. This is the key enabler for AI-driven status reporting.
acceptanceCriteria: getStatusReport() method added to PortfolioTaskModel with portfolio_id and period_days parameters
Method returns structured dict with: portfolio, generated_at, period_start, period_end, milestones[], task_summary, completed_tasks[], critical_blockers[], at_risk_items[], dependency_health
completed_tasks computed by filtering tasks with date_completed within the period window
critical_blockers lists blocked tasks sorted by blocked_by_count descending
at_risk_items includes both at-risk milestones and overdue active tasks
dependency_health includes total_edges, resolved, unresolved, critical_path_length
getPortfolioStatusReport API callback registered in Plugin.php with period_days default of 7
Method is read-only — no apiAccessMap entry needed (defaults to APP_USER)
3+ unit tests: empty portfolio returns zero counts, portfolio with data returns correct period filtering, custom period_days parameter works
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Pure backend — no template changes. This is the highest-value enhancement because it immediately enables agentic status reporting via the JSON-RPC API.

userStories.title: Add weighted milestone progress (model + API + config)
userStories.description: Extend MilestoneModel::getProgress() to accept an optional weight_by parameter supporting three modes: 'count' (default, current behavior), 'score' (story points from tasks.score), and 'time_estimated' (hours from tasks.time_estimated). Add a portfolio_milestone_weight_by config setting. Update the getMilestoneProgress API callback to pass weight_by through. Update getOverviewMilestones in PortfolioTaskModel to include score_total, score_completed, time_total, time_completed fields.
acceptanceCriteria: MilestoneModel::getProgress() accepts optional string $weightBy parameter (default 'count')
weight_by='count' produces identical output to current behavior (backward compatible)
weight_by='score' computes percent as completed_score/total_score using tasks.score field
weight_by='time_estimated' computes percent as completed_time/total_time using tasks.time_estimated field
When total_score or total_time is 0, percent defaults to 0.0 and a 'no_data' flag is set to true
getOverviewMilestones includes score_total, score_completed, time_total, time_completed in each milestone summary
getMilestoneProgress API callback passes weight_by parameter through to model
portfolio_milestone_weight_by config setting added with default 'count'
ConfigController::save() handles the new setting
Template/config/settings.php shows a dropdown for weight_by (Count / Story Points / Time Estimated)
4+ unit tests covering each weight mode plus the no-data edge case
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
New translation strings added to Locale/en_US/translations.php
userStories.notes: Backend-focused but includes config UI. The template milestone views (show.php, portfolio/show.php) are updated in US-003.

userStories.title: Add weight-mode selector to milestone templates
userStories.description: Update the milestone detail page (Template/milestone/show.php) and the portfolio dashboard milestone health section (Template/portfolio/show.php) to display weighted progress. Milestone show page gets a dropdown selector (count/score/time) that reloads with the selected weight mode. Portfolio dashboard shows score_total/score_completed and time_total/time_completed columns when data is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Template/milestone/show.php shows a weight-mode selector dropdown (Count / Story Points / Time Estimated)
Selecting a weight mode reloads the page with ?weight_by=score (or time_estimated) query parameter
MilestoneController::show() reads weight_by from request params and passes to getProgress()
Progress bar reflects the selected weight mode
When no_data flag is true for score/time modes, show 'No score data available' or 'No time estimates available' instead of the progress bar
Template/portfolio/show.php milestone health table includes Score and Time columns when data exists
All template output escaped with $this->text->e()
All user-visible strings wrapped in t()
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Template-only changes. Depends on US-002 for the weighted getProgress() model method and config setting.

userStories.title: Add portfolio activity stream (model + API)
userStories.description: Add a getPortfolioActivity(portfolio_id, limit=25, offset=0) method that aggregates task activity from all portfolio projects into a unified feed. Query the project_activities table joined to portfolio_has_projects to scope by portfolio membership. Enrich each activity record with project_name. Register as a JSON-RPC API method.
acceptanceCriteria: getActivity() method added to PortfolioTaskModel with portfolio_id, limit, and offset parameters
Method queries project_activities table for activities in portfolio member projects
Each activity record includes: id, project_id, project_name, task_id, event_name, creator_id, date_creation, data
Results ordered by date_creation descending (newest first)
Pagination via limit and offset — limit clamped to [1, 100], default 25
Defensive try/catch — returns empty array if project_activities table doesn't exist
getPortfolioActivity API callback registered in Plugin.php
3+ unit tests: empty portfolio, portfolio with activities, pagination
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Backend only. The dashboard template integration is in US-005.

userStories.title: Add activity feed to portfolio dashboard template
userStories.description: Add an activity feed section below the overview metrics on the portfolio dashboard (Template/portfolio/show.php). The controller fetches the latest 10 activities and passes them to the template. Each activity item shows: timestamp, event type, task title with link, project name, and creator name.
acceptanceCriteria: PortfolioViewController::show() calls getActivity(portfolio_id, 10) and passes result to template
Template/portfolio/show.php includes a 'Recent Activity' section below milestone health
Each activity item renders: date, event description, task link, project name
Empty state message shown when no activities exist
Activity section uses portfolio- prefixed CSS classes
All output escaped with $this->text->e()
All strings wrapped in t()
New translation strings added to Locale/en_US/translations.php
1+ controller test verifying activity data is passed to template
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Template + controller changes. Depends on US-004 for the getActivity() model method.

userStories.title: Add portfolio workload API method
userStories.description: Add a getPortfolioWorkload(portfolio_id) method that aggregates per-user task metrics across all portfolio projects. For each user with assigned tasks: task_count, active_task_count, overdue_task_count, blocked_task_count, total_score, total_estimated_hours, total_spent_hours, and a per-project breakdown. Also compute an 'unassigned' bucket. Add a portfolio_workload_threshold config setting for overload detection.
acceptanceCriteria: getWorkload() method added to PortfolioTaskModel with portfolio_id parameter
Returns dict with 'users' array and 'unassigned' dict
Each user entry includes: user_id, username, name, task_count, active_task_count, overdue_task_count, blocked_task_count, total_score, total_estimated_hours, total_spent_hours, projects[] breakdown
Overdue computed by comparing tasks.date_due to current time for active tasks
Blocked count uses existing dependency stats from buildTaskDependencyStats()
unassigned bucket counts tasks with owner_id=0
portfolio_workload_threshold config setting added (default: 15 active tasks)
getPortfolioWorkload API callback registered in Plugin.php
ConfigController::save() handles the new setting
Template/config/settings.php shows the threshold input
3+ unit tests: empty portfolio, portfolio with mixed user loads, unassigned tasks
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
New translation strings added to Locale/en_US/translations.php
userStories.notes: Backend + config. The workload view template is in US-007.

userStories.title: Add workload view template and route
userStories.description: Add a 'Team' tab to the portfolio sidebar and a workload view page showing per-user task allocation. The controller calls getWorkload() and passes data to a new template. The template shows a table with per-user metrics, color-coded overload indicators, and click-through links to the filtered task list.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /portfolio/:portfolio_id/workload registered in Plugin.php
applicationAccessMap grants APP_USER access to PortfolioViewController workload action
PortfolioViewController::workload() fetches portfolio, validates existence, calls getWorkload(), renders template
Template/portfolio/_sidebar.php includes 'Team' link (active state when $active === 'workload')
Template/portfolio/workload.php shows a table with columns: User, Active Tasks, Overdue, Blocked, Score, Est. Hours, Spent Hours
Users exceeding portfolio_workload_threshold have a red/warning indicator on their row
Each user row links to /portfolio/:portfolio_id/tasks?assignee_id=:user_id
Unassigned row shown at bottom with task counts
Empty state message when portfolio has no projects or tasks
CSS classes use portfolio-workload- prefix
All output escaped, all strings localized
2+ controller tests: renders template with workload data, redirects when portfolio not found
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Template + controller + route + CSS. Depends on US-006 for the getWorkload() model method.

userStories.title: Add roadmap view — controller, route, and data preparation
userStories.description: Add a roadmap view that shows milestones as horizontal bars on a high-level timeline. The controller fetches milestones with their progress and earliest/latest task dates, prepares a structured JSON payload for D3.js rendering, and passes it to a new template. Register the route and sidebar link.
acceptanceCriteria: Route /portfolio/:portfolio_id/roadmap registered in Plugin.php
applicationAccessMap grants APP_USER access to PortfolioViewController roadmap action
PortfolioViewController::roadmap() fetches portfolio, milestones, and computes per-milestone date ranges (earliest task date_due → target_date)
Each milestone in the roadmap data includes: id, name, color_id, start_date (earliest task), end_date (target_date), percent, health (on_track/at_risk/overdue), task_count
Roadmap JSON payload passed to template via data attribute (same pattern as gantt.php)
Template/portfolio/_sidebar.php includes 'Roadmap' link after Timeline (active state when $active === 'roadmap')
Template/portfolio/roadmap.php renders the chart container with data attribute and loads D3 + portfolio-gantt.js
Empty state message when no milestones have target dates
1+ controller test verifying roadmap data structure
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Controller + route + template shell. The D3 rendering is in US-009.

userStories.title: Add roadmap D3.js renderer and CSS
userStories.description: Add a renderRoadmap(container, data) function to Asset/js/portfolio-gantt.js that renders milestone bars as horizontal bars on a time axis. Bars are color-coded by health status (green=on-track, yellow=at-risk, red=overdue). Each bar has a progress fill showing completion percentage. A 'today' line marks the current date. Clicking a bar navigates to the milestone detail page. Add corresponding CSS.
acceptanceCriteria: window.PortfolioGantt.renderRoadmap(container, data) function added to Asset/js/portfolio-gantt.js
Each milestone renders as a horizontal bar from start_date to end_date
Bar fill reflects percent complete (e.g., 60% filled for 60% progress)
Bar color: green (#22c55e) for on_track, yellow (#eab308) for at_risk, red (#ef4444) for overdue
Milestone name label rendered to the left of or inside the bar
Vertical 'today' line rendered as a dashed red line at the current date
Clicking a milestone bar navigates to /milestone/:milestone_id
Bottom axis shows month/week labels (D3 timeScale)
Responsive: adjusts to container width
CSS classes use portfolio-roadmap- prefix
ES5-compatible JavaScript (no ES6+ syntax), no build step
Template/portfolio/roadmap.php calls renderRoadmap on DOMContentLoaded
PHP lint passes, all existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Client-side JS + CSS. Depends on US-008 for the controller/template that provides the data. Follows the same pattern as renderGantt() — D3 v7 is already bundled.
